intro: Many of our veneer patients do not live in Florida. They send photos from Atlanta, Houston, Dallas or New York, get a written estimate, and fly in for one Monday-to-Thursday week. The reason it fits in a week is simple: our [lab is in the building](/custom-lab), so the veneers are milled, finished and adjusted between visits instead of being shipped to another city and back.

This page is the whole trip, in order: what happens from home, the three visits, the partner hotels, how to get from the airport, what to pack and who can come with you. The same schedule applies to [porcelain veneers](/porcelain-veneers-miami) on a few teeth and to the 20-veneer [Smile Design](/smile-design-miami). Full mouth restoration takes two weeks and All-on-X is planned separately; your coordinator tells you which applies before you book anything.

Veneers bonded, bite checked, {warrantyYears}-year warranty handed over in writing.
visits.time: About 2 hours. Fly home the same evening.

fromHome.title: What happens from home first
fromHome.aside: Nothing is booked until you have the number in writing. Most patients do all of this in a week of evenings.

items.d: Three photos of your smile from your phone, through the [free photo evaluation](/free-photo-evaluation). No visit, no cost.
Within {replyHours} hours during office hours, with the treatment plan: which teeth, veneer or crown per tooth, and anything that needs treating first.
The total, in writing, from the [published price list](/veneers-cost-miami). The number you see is the number you pay unless the exam at Visit 1 finds something new.
Pre-qualify with one of six [financing partners](/financing) with a soft credit check, or pay in full. Your coordinator helps with the application.
A ${depositUsd} deposit, applied to your treatment, holds the three visits. We send the hotel list and the pickup details the same day.
Arrive Sunday evening or early Monday; fly home Thursday evening. You book directly, with the partner rate for Hilton and Marriott.

perks.d: Three vetted hotels within 10 minutes, with Hilton and Marriott partner rates at 20% off for our patients. You book directly; we send the list with your estimate.
MIA is 15 minutes away. We send you the rideshare pickup spot at arrivals and the clinic address for Visit 1; you book the ride.
Uber and Lyft pick up at our front door. We send the pickup details for each visit; rides are booked and paid by you.
One person, by text, from first message to the flight home.
Video check-in two weeks after delivery. Your warranty is honored by any dentist for small adjustments.
A free day between preparation and delivery. Beach, Wynwood or just rest.

travel.title: Airport, rides and hotel, plainly
body: We are a dental clinic, not a travel agency, so this is what we do and do not do. We send you a short list of three hotels within ten minutes of the clinic, two of them Hilton and Marriott properties where our patients get a partner rate of 20% off. You book the room yourself, directly with the hotel. We do not arrange hotels, airport pickups or rides, and nothing travel-related is included in the price of treatment.

The clinic is at 8396 SW 8th St, on the second floor, about 15 minutes from Miami International Airport by car and 45 minutes to an hour from Fort Lauderdale. Uber and Lyft pick up at the airport and at our front door; a car is not needed for the week. If you drive in from Orlando or Tampa, there is parking at the building. Your coordinator sends the pickup spot at arrivals and the clinic address before you land, and the pickup details for each visit the evening before.

pack.title: What to pack
pack.intro: Less than you think. The clinic has everything for the visits; this is what makes the week easier.
items: Your written estimate and the ID you booked with. Your doctor already has your photos and the plan.
A list of medications you take, and your night guard if you already wear one.
Sunglasses: the Wednesday off is a free day in Miami, and you will be in temporaries, so a soft lunch spot beats a steakhouse.
Soft foods are easier for the two days in temporaries. Nothing is forbidden, but you will not want to bite into a baguette on Tuesday night.
A charged phone. Your coordinator reaches you by text, and the pickup details for each visit arrive the evening before.
If you were asked to whiten first, bring the shade you finished at. The veneers are matched to it in the chair.

companions.title: Who can come with you
companions.body: Anyone you like. Partners, parents and friends are welcome in the waiting area and in the private consultation room at Visit 1, where the design is reviewed; Yolanda and Erick from Fort Worth came together, and her words are on the Dallas page. During preparation and bonding a companion waits in the lobby, and both visits are short enough to plan the day around. Children are welcome in the waiting area with an adult. If you come alone, that is normal too: nothing in the week requires an escort. Veneer visits are done under local anesthesia, so you can take a rideshare home after each one.

cities.title: Patients come from
cities.intro: Flight times, a sample Monday-to-Thursday itinerary, what it costs to come and a patient's own words, for the cities we see most. Everywhere else works the same way; send photos and we plan the week with you.

items.name: Atlanta
items.d: Under two hours nonstop. Fly in Monday morning, home Thursday evening.

items.name: Houston
items.d: About two and a half hours nonstop from Bush or Hobby.

items.name: Dallas–Fort Worth
items.d: Just under three hours nonstop from DFW.

items.name: New York
items.d: Three hours from JFK, LaGuardia or Newark, with flights every hour.

items.name: Orlando
items.d: Three and a half to four hours by car or train, or an hour by air.

items.name: Tampa
items.d: Four hours by car across Alligator Alley, or just over an hour by air.
